name: quick_smoke
description: Small manual comparison helper for verifying the Glock lab matrix tooling. It helps structure a quick pass, not prove gameplay truth by itself.

steps.name: baseline_unarmored
steps.operatorNote: Take one careful recovered shot, then exercise hold-to-fire rejection and one moving shot.

steps.name: cs_tight_headprotected
steps.operatorNote: Focus on one deliberate headshot attempt and at least one torso versus head comparison.
